Overview

Coro is a city in I with a population of 200,000. A UNESCO World Heritage colonial city near the Caribbean coast, known for its unique mud architecture and sand dunes. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year.
